name: channel_equal_priority_does_not_preempt
description: Strictly greater priority preempts; equal priority does not. Without the strictness two identical producers — two microphones, or two copies of the desktop app — take the channel from each other on every frame and neither ever publishes. An implementation that used >= here would look correct with one producer and fail only when a second appeared.

steps.description: the channel is free, so the first claim takes it
an equal claim is refused and the holder is named
the owner renewing is not a fresh take: the sequence high-water mark has to survive, or a renewal reopens the channel to replayed packets
one higher preempts, and the loser is told so it can stop immediately
